requirements.title: Name-, storage-, or inheritance-associated pointers change association status together
requirements.definition: While two pointers are name associated, storage associated, or inheritance associated, a change in association status of one pointer changes the association status of the other accordingly.

pending.name-associated-pointer-status-propagate: Pointer actual p starts NULL; subroutine pointer dummy q is name associated with p, assigns q=>target t=42, returns, and caller observes ASSOCIATED(p,t) true plus p exact 42.
pending.storage-associated-pointer-status-propag: Source-control plan is deferred to the storage-association owner for a conforming pair of storage-associated pointer objects; this catalogue will only assert status propagation after that owner establishes the association form.
pending.inheritance-associated-pointer-status-pr: Source-control plan is deferred to the inheritance-association owner for a conforming parent/extension pointer association; this catalogue will only assert status propagation after that owner establishes the association form.

requirements.title: VOLATILE pointer association status may change by means not specified by the program
requirements.definition: The association status of a pointer object with VOLATILE might change by means not specified by the program.

pending.volatile-pointer-status-external-change-: No portable single-image oracle can force or forbid a status change by means not specified in the program; future tests may only avoid assuming stability of VOLATILE pointer status across such means.
